title: Carbon
desc: Shankar has dreams that often come true. One day, when his father meets with an accident, he tries to find the identity of the hit-and-run driver through his dreams.

title: Mister
desc: When Chai finds out that Meera loves Siddharth, he does everything in his power to unite them, even though he is madly in love with her.

title: Mirai
desc: When a vicious villain sets out to claim nine sacred books that hold the secret to immortality, the guardian of the ninth book ties a happy-go-lucky orphan's destiny to the quest to protect them.

title: Sakka Podu Podu Raja
desc: Santa turns Bhavani, a gangster, into his enemy after helping his friend elope with the thug's sister. Later, Santa falls in love with a girl, who turns out to be Bhavani's younger sister.

title: Thuparivaalan
desc: An experienced detective investigates the death of a child's pet dog and inadvertently unravels a sinister web of unsolved murders.
After witnessing repeated nightmares of a woman being killed, an investigative journalist goes on to find out its truth.

title: Aaranya Kaandam
desc: Singaperumal still feels mighty though he has turned older. However, when he tries to beat his arch-enemy Gajendran with a perfect plan, a series of incidents lead to a dog-eat-dog situation.

title: Poraali
desc: Kumaran and Nallavan relocate to Chennai to start a new life. Though they get employed and are successful in the beginning, eventually their past comes to haunt them.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Oosaravelli
desc: Tony, a man involved in mercenary activities, saves an abducted woman, Niharika, from a group of hooligans. Later, he falls in love with her and sets out to avenge the deaths of her family members.

title: D Block
desc: When the female students of an engineering college mysteriously disappear and are found dead, a young man and his friends decide to look for the culprit.

title: Lift
desc: A man's first day on the job turns into a nightmare after some vengeful spirits begin to create trouble by trapping him in an elevator.

title: Ragalai
desc: Karthik's mother decides to marry him to her brother's daughter Indu. However, when the uncle insults Karthik's family, he goes on a mission to destroy him.

title: Pathu Endrathukulla
desc: A driving instructor is tasked to deliver Shakeela, a young woman, to a landlord in Mussoorie. But soon, he finds out that her life is in danger and decides to be her saviour.

title: Surya's Saturday
desc: Surya, a young man with anger issues, channels his emotions on Saturdays, because of a promise to his deceased mother. However, things get complicated when he decides to confront a corrupt cop.
Sathya, a young policeman, curses his luck when he gets posted in a control room. However, his life takes an unusual turn after the 100th call he overhears.
